source: Matrix for Grading and Residential Fire Plan Review Determination, effective 08/13/2026
note: Outside reviews the Building Division routes a project to. Each trigger is the City threshold. Decide each fact from the plans, application and site facts; an unknown fact stays unknown.

triggered_when_any: Project scope is new building
Project scope is new detached adu
Addition area (sq ft) is more than 1000
Basement excavation
Retaining wall with cut, back-cut or backfill
Cut-and-fill operation
Slope restoration, repair or modification
Landslide repair or removal
Tract grading
Civil drawings in the plan set
triggers.source: Matrix for Grading and Residential Fire Plan Review Determination, effective 08/13/2026

triggered_when_any: Temporary or permanent shoring
triggers.source: When Is a Geotechnical/Soils Report Required?, effective 6/17/2026

triggered_when_any: Project scope is new building
Project scope is new detached adu
Creates a new dwelling unit
Project scope is new attached adu
Addition area (sq ft) is more than 1000
Remodel, alteration or renovation (% of the building) is more than 50
all of: Landscape or hardscape work; and Fire Hazard Severity Zone is one of very_high
Fire Department site access plan required
not_triggered_when: The building is commercial, industrial or mixed use, or multifamily other than townhomes (the Fire Department review applies instead)
triggers.source: Matrix for Grading and Residential Fire Plan Review Determination, effective 08/13/2026

triggered_when_any: all of: Commercial, industrial or mixed-use building, or multifamily other than townhomes; and any of: Project scope is new building; or Addition area (sq ft) is more than 0; or Change of occupancy group; or Work in an assembly space (A occupancy); or Commercial cooking equipment (range, oven, fryer, hood); or Battery energy storage system; or Fire sprinkler, fire alarm or fire monitoring work; or New or modified wireless facility; or Temporary tent, membrane structure or event booths; or Hazardous process or materials (spray booth, hazardous materials storage); or Fire Department site access plan required
staff_decide_when: Other full plan review work in a commercial, industrial, mixed-use or multifamily building that matches none of the triggers above and none of the not-triggered cases below: a same-use office or retail tenant improvement, hotel guest room work, a demolition, an interior alteration
not_triggered_when: The building is a single family home, duplex, ADU, JADU or townhome
Work on the City's over-the-counter list, a reroof, or a sign
Exterior repair or refinish of an existing building with no added floor area (siding, stucco, awnings, stairs, windows or doors)
Interior repair (drywall, finishes, fixtures in place)
Interior remodel of a dwelling unit, a deck, or a balcony in a multifamily building with no change of occupancy and no added floor area
EV chargers, or solar with no battery storage
Removing a wireless facility with nothing added
Site work with no building (retaining wall, paving, parking, accessible route, playground)
triggers.source: LBFD "Construction & the Fire Code" page (multi-family, commercial and industrial new construction and remodel projects are routed to the Fire Department); Building Permit Issuance handout row 2 (Fire Department Approval criterion)

triggered_when_any: Shoring cut depth (ft) is more than 6
Oceanfront site
A bluff setback applies to the parcel is more than 0
Site slope (%) is more than 50
State liquefaction hazard zone
Expansive soils
Mapped major landslide area
Soil or structure failure
Non-conventional foundation
Building Official requires it
triggers.source: When Is a Geotechnical/Soils Report Required?, effective 6/17/2026

triggered_when_any: Disturbed earth area (sq ft, including landscape and hardscape) is at least 500
Impervious area (sq ft) is at least 10000
all of: Impervious area (sq ft) is at least 5000; and Redevelopment project
all of: Impervious area (sq ft) is at least 5000; and Site slope (%) is at least 25
all of: Impervious area (sq ft) is at least 2500; and Water Quality Environmentally Sensitive Area
triggers.source: Water Quality Requirements for Land Development, Section C
